contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANS PF AVG ; R/ GLORI A EXER CITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constans (333-350), Trier mint Gloria Exercitus issue of 336-340, possibly RIC volume 8, no. 86, issue of 340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust diademed, draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANS PF AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them, the standard bears M on a large square vexillum. Reverse inscription: GLORI A EXER CITVS. In exergue: TRP. Diameter: 15.4mm, Weight: 1.92gms, die axis: 12
